offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace that connects homeowners with local home repair, maintenance and improvement professionals. Sells memberships and per-lead or per-job fees to those professionals and offers homeowners online booking and reviews.

primary_services.value: online matching of homeowners with local pros; service booking; pro ratings and reviews

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners seeking repair, maintenance and improvement work; B2B: local home service contractors and professionals listed on the platform

end_markets.value: home services; home repair; home improvement; home maintenance

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly memberships paid by service professionals for platform access; transaction or usage fees: per-lead and per-job fees paid by service professionals

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace matching homeowners with service professionals, sold to professionals and consumers; service provider: booking and coordination of home service jobs for homeowners, with fees taken from pros

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across the United States, current international scope uncertain

specialization.value: niche specialist: single online home services marketplace line

distribution_channels.value: online: website and mobile apps where homeowners find and book pros; direct sales: sales teams signing up local service professionals as paying members

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules, consumer protection, advertising and data privacy laws apply

notes: Description is based on general knowledge of the company; current international operations are uncertain.
